race.comment: EYE TRACKER (11) beat home GAELIC KIWI (6) when they clashed here over 2470m last start. They jumped virtually the same price and there wasn't much in it but EYE TRACKER was the better run and maps better again from the soft gate which clearly gives her the edge once more. GAELIC KIWI is going well and the run two back at Geelong says he could even go a little better. CHURCHILLENA (10) has only raced twice but looks one that will keep improving over further having drawn for a good run. BALDONI (2) wasn't beaten far at Seymour latest and is in the mix from SOBINE (9) who was behind the top pair last time but had been solid prior.
